user.title: Add an MDtronix unit
user.description: Enter the unit's IP address. It must be set up in the MDtronix app as MDtronix Smart Nivas and on the same Wi-Fi as Home Assistant.

key.title: Enter the key for {name}
key.description: Home Assistant can only collect the key by itself in the 10 minutes after the unit joins Wi-Fi from a setup. Open the unit in the MDtronix app, tap Smart Nivas key, and type it in here.

error.cannot_connect: The unit didn't answer. Check it is on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.invalid_key: The unit refused this key. Check it against the MDtronix app.
error.invalid_key_format: A key is 32 letters and digits (0-9, a-f).

abort.cannot_connect: The unit didn't answer. Check it is on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
abort.not_nivas: This unit isn't in Smart Nivas mode. Set it up again in the MDtronix app and choose MDtronix Smart Nivas.
abort.not_supported: This MDtronix device isn't supported yet.

init.title: Tank
init.description: The unit measures the level, not the volume. Enter the tank's size to see water in litres, including for the Energy dashboard. 0 means not set.

start_not_below_stop.message: The start level must be below the stop level ({stop}%).

stop_not_above_start.message: The stop level must be above the start level ({start}%).
